screening.reach: Lucy Stone Park in Warren to Route 67, about 5.2–5.3 miles, Class II–III
screening.demandSignal: American Whitewater describes a named whitewater reach with Mouse Hole, Broken Dam, Angel's Field and Devil's Gorge; Town of Warren promotes Lucy Stone Park's riverside paddling beach.
screening.scoringSignal: Direct USGS 01176000 stage/discharge; Old Paddlers Almanac gives a 3.8-foot/260 cfs minimum cue and USACE publishes 1,250 cfs warning / 1,840 cfs flood references.
screening.access: Lucy Stone Park paddling beach at 42.2175,-72.1931667; Wrights Complex lower-dam river-right take-out at river mile 14.25 (42.212,-72.2325) and relaunch below at river mile 14.15 (42.211833,-72.233667); West Warren alternate seal launch starts below the dam and uses South Street/Main Street parking; Route 67 circular pull-off at 42.2035,-72.263. The Lucy Stone itinerary's portage is about 0.1 mile; stay off active railroad tracks and mill property.
screening.safety: Reviewed PFD/helmet/cold-water, strainer, whitewater, dam, private-bank and no-cell-service controls; route ends at the documented Route 67 take-out.
screening.camping: Quinebaug Cove Campground in Brimfield lists reservable tent and camper sites as a separate nearby private basecamp; no riverbank or access-site camping.
screening.duplicateReview: The Lucy Stone route and West Warren alternate-start route share the downstream reach, but the latter starts below the mandatory dam portage and is 2.6 miles shorter. American Whitewater documents this distinct seal-launch option and separate parking direction; it is retained as a useful alternate trip start, with the overlap disclosed rather than silently counted as an independent full corridor. The alternate Whitewater take-out remains a future screen.

thresholdEvidence.reachApplicability: Minimum cue is from a paddler almanac; USACE warning/flood values are hazard references. Verify live stage, discharge, trend, wood and local notices.

duplicateReview.notes: Lucy Stone-to-Route 67 is the named full reach. West Warren below-dam-to-Route 67 is a shorter alternate trip start explicitly listed by American Whitewater; it avoids the factory-dam portage and shares only the downstream section. Keep the overlap visible and do not describe it as a separate watershed corridor.

validation: Canonical geometry generation and audit passed.
Both route cards have attributed same-river Quaboag gallery context.
